name: Weekly Dev Summary — n8n + Claude (Opire bounty #5)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $('Config').first().json.anthropic_model, max_tokens: 1024, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: $json.prompt }] }) }}

parameters.content:
## Setup (see README.md)
1. Fill the Config node: repo, language EN/FR, Anthropic key, model, Slack webhook URL.
2. Activate the workflow — the Friday 17:00 schedule is already set.
3. Optional: press "Execute workflow" to run it immediately.

## Notes
- GitHub collection paginates via Link headers (up to 50 pages) and filters to the trailing 7 days.
- Closed issues exclude PRs; merged PRs come from the pulls endpoint filtered on merged_at.
- The bounty spec named claude-sonnet-4-20250514, retired June 2026; the Config default is claude-sonnet-4-6 (current, configurable).
- Empty weeks produce a one-sentence quiet-week note, never an empty post.
